name: pdist2
expr: D0 = pdist2(A, B); Dm = pdist2(A, B, 'minkowski', 3); Dc = pdist2(A, B, 'cityblock'); Dh = pdist2(A, B, 'chebychev'); Dco = pdist2(A, B, 'cosine'); Dma = pdist2(X, Y, 'mahalanobis'); [Ds, Is] = pdist2(A, B, 'euclidean', 'Smallest', 2); [Dl, Il] = pdist2(A, B, 'euclidean', 'Largest', 2);
comment: Sig: D = pdist2(X, Y, metric); [D, I] = pdist2(X, Y, metric, 'Smallest'|'Largest', k). Coverage: default euclidean, minkowski p=3, cityblock, chebychev, cosine, mahalanobis (cov(Y) default), Smallest k, Largest k. Function-handle metric NOT supported (deferred).
